name: Aerospace and industrial components
status: draft: tags proposed by Claude; carbon tag and Japanese names added on the 22 Oct 2026 run, rebuilt from that page on 23 Oct 2026

engines.label: Engines and engine programmes
engines.def: Engine makers and risk-and-revenue-sharing partners: sell engines or engine modules at low or negative margin and earn on spare parts and service over the engine's life.

components.label: Aero components, systems and materials
components.def: Proprietary parts, systems and specialty materials sold to aircraft and engine makers and to airlines; earnings tied to aircraft build rates and the installed fleet.

aftermarket.label: Aftermarket services and distribution
aftermarket.def: Maintenance, repair and overhaul, used and new parts distribution; earnings tied to flight hours and shop visits, not to new aircraft builds.

airframers.label: Aircraft makers
airframers.def: Final assembly of commercial, business or military aircraft.

defence.label: Defence primes and diversified A&D
defence.def: Prime contractors whose largest customer is a government defence budget, and diversified aerospace and defence groups.

motion.label: Motion and power transmission
motion.def: Bearings, gears, belts, hydraulics, pneumatics and motion control sold to industrial machinery makers and as replacement parts.

flow.label: Flow control and fluid handling
flow.def: Pumps, valves, actuators, seals and dispensing equipment for process industries; a large share is replacement and service.

instruments.label: Instruments and electromechanical
instruments.def: Test, measurement and analytical instruments and engineered electromechanical components sold to process, aerospace, medical, power and industrial customers; a large share is niche, high-margin and acquisition-built.

carbon.label: Carbon, fibres and composite materials
carbon.def: Carbon fibre, graphite, composite and engineered-fabric materials sold to aerospace, industrial and energy customers; earnings tied to capacity utilisation and input costs.

NYSE_GE.name: GE Aerospace
NYSE_GE.why: Commercial and military jet engines; services are most of profit. History before FY2024 includes GE Vernova and GE HealthCare.
NYSE_GE.window_why: GE HealthCare spin-off (Jan 2023) and GE Vernova spin-off (Apr 2024); FY2025 is the first year with both balance sheets on GE Aerospace alone

XLON_RR..name: Rolls-Royce
XLON_RR..why: Civil Aerospace (wide-body engines, paid per flight hour) is the largest segment; Defence and Power Systems are smaller.

XPAR_SAF.name: Safran
XPAR_SAF.why: Propulsion (CFM with GE) is the largest segment; equipment and interiors are the rest.

XETR_MTX.name: MTU Aero Engines
XETR_MTX.why: Engine module partner on GTF, V2500, GE9X and others, plus engine MRO.

XLON_MRO.name: Melrose (GKN Aerospace)
XLON_MRO.why: GKN Engines (risk-and-revenue-sharing engine parts) is the larger profit segment; Structures is the rest.
XLON_MRO.window_why: Dowlais (GKN Automotive and Powder Metallurgy) demerged Apr 2023; FY2024 is the first year with both balance sheets on aerospace alone

NYSE_TDG.name: TransDigm
NYSE_TDG.why: Proprietary sole-source parts; about half of revenue from the aftermarket.

NYSE_HEI.name: HEICO
NYSE_HEI.why: Flight Support (approved replacement parts and repair) and Electronic Technologies; parts maker more than service provider.

NASDAQ_WWD.name: Woodward

NYSE_CW.name: Curtiss-Wright

NYSE_MOG.A.name: Moog

NYSE_HXL.name: Hexcel

NYSE_DCO.name: Ducommun

NASDAQ_ATRO.name: Astronics

NYSE_ATI.name: ATI

XLON_SNR.name: Senior plc

TSX_MAL.name: Magellan Aerospace

NASDAQ_HONA.name: Honeywell Aerospace

NYSE_AIR.name: AAR

NYSE_SARO.name: StandardAero

NYSE_ESE.why: Largest segment is Aerospace & Defense (filtration, composites, naval signature management after the 2025 Ultra Maritime purchase); also utility test instruments (Doble) and RF test. Tagged to aero components on the largest segment; draft, to confirm with the segment mix.

NYSE_AME.name: AMETEK
NYSE_AME.why: Electronic instruments (analytical, test, aerospace, power) and electromechanical components; not mainly aerospace, so a new tag under industrial components. With fewer than 6 tagged peers the Industry group widens to all industrial components (motion, flow, instruments).

NASDAQ_BELFB.name: Bel Fuse
NASDAQ_BELFB.why: Engineered electronic components (power supplies and converters, connectors, magnetics) sold to aerospace, defence, networking, data-centre and industrial customers; not mainly aerospace, so placed with AMETEK under instruments and electromechanical. With fewer than 6 tagged peers the Industry group widens to all industrial components.

TSE_3402.name: Toray Industries
TSE_3402.why: Fibres and textiles, performance chemicals and carbon fibre composites (the world's largest carbon-fibre maker; Boeing and Airbus supplier); aerospace is a small share of group sales, so tagged with carbon, fibre and composite makers. Data from Japanese filings (FocusAlpha), not Fiscal.ai.

TSE_5302.name: Nippon Carbon
TSE_5302.why: Graphite electrodes and fine carbon for steel and industry, plus silicon-carbide fibre (Nicalon, through a joint venture with GE and Safran for engine ceramic composites). Data from Japanese filings (FocusAlpha), not Fiscal.ai.

NYSE_AIN.name: Albany International
NYSE_AIN.why: Engineered composites for aerospace (3D-woven LEAP fan blades and cases) plus paper-machine clothing.

NYSE_EAF.name: GrafTech International
NYSE_EAF.why: Graphite electrodes for electric arc furnace steelmaking and petroleum needle coke; the closest listed peer of Nippon Carbon's electrode business.

XSWX_GURN.name: Gurit
XSWX_GURN.why: Composite materials (core materials, prepregs) and kitting, mainly for wind blades, plus aerospace and marine.

XETR_SGL.name: SGL Carbon
XETR_SGL.why: Specialty graphite (semiconductor, battery), carbon fibres and composites; sold its graphite-electrode business to Showa Denko in 2017.

XBRU_SYENS.name: Syensqo
XBRU_SYENS.why: Specialty polymers and composite materials (carbon-fibre prepregs for aerospace) spun off from Solvay in December 2023; carve-out history from 2020.
XBRU_SYENS.window_why: Separated from Solvay in Dec 2023; earlier years are a carve-out

TSE_6268.name: Nabtesco
TSE_6268.why: Precision reduction gears for robots, hydraulics, railway and aircraft flight-control equipment, marine controls and automatic doors; motion control is the largest profit pool. Data from Japanese filings (FocusAlpha), not Fiscal.ai.

TSE_6479.name: MinebeaMitsumi
TSE_6479.why: Miniature and small ball bearings (a large aerospace bearing supplier), rod-end and spherical bearings, motors, sensors, semiconductors and access products; bearings are the core profit pool. Data from Japanese filings (FocusAlpha), not Fiscal.ai.
